relevance.reasoning: 試驗主題為類風濕病患全肩關節置換術前後的免疫抑制劑管理，並非評估 Ixekizumab 對 rheumatoid vasculitis 的治療效果；入組族群為廣泛類風濕病患，與本適應症相關性極低。Phase 2，尚未招募，n=80。

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: IL-17A 可促進血管內皮細胞活化、嗜中性白血球浸潤及血管壁重塑，在 ANCA 相關血管炎與 RA 相關血管炎中有炎症貢獻。理論上 IL-17A 抑制可減輕血管壁 Th17 驅動的損傷，但此機轉尚屬推測層次，無直接臨床試驗針對 rheumatoid vasculitis 設計。
IL-17A 在造血微環境中具部分免疫調節角色，理論上可能影響白血病細胞與骨髓基質細胞互動，但此為高度間接推測。目前無任何臨床前模型或臨床數據支持 IL-17A 抑制於 ALL 的療效；TxGNN 高分可能反映淋巴系疾病節點的圖譜拓撲相似性。

predicted_indications.disease_name: chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma with immunoglobulin heavy chain variable-region gene somatic hypermutation

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: 此為 CLL/SLL 特定分子亞型（具 IGHV 體細胞超突變，預後較佳亞群），與 IL-17A 抑制之間無已知生物學關聯。預測分數可能源於 KG 中淋巴腫瘤節點群集效應，不具再利用機轉合理性。

predicted_indications.disease_name: pregerminal center chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: 前生發中心 CLL/SLL 亞型（IGHV 未突變，侵襲性較高），與上一 CLL 亞型共享相同 TxGNN 分數（0.9707），顯示預測來自相同圖譜節點聚合，而非個別生物學關聯。IL-17A 抑制於此亞型無機轉基礎。
尾骨過度活動為機械性關節不穩定疾患，病理以韌帶鬆弛與骨性結構異常為主，非 IL-17A 驅動的炎症過程。TxGNN 高預測分數（0.969）可能源於脊椎解剖部位節點與炎症性脊椎病節點在 KG 中的鄰近效應，屬圖譜噪訊。

literature.abstract: Ixekizumab, a high-affinity interleukin-17A (IL-17A) monoclonal antibody, has previously shown efficacy in radiographic axial spondyloarthritis (also known as ankylosing spondylitis). We aimed to evaluate the efficacy and safety of ixekizumab, an IL-17 inhibitor, in non-radiographic axial spondyloarthritis. Here, we report the primary results of COAST-X.

literature.title: Risk of new-onset and recurrent uveitis with different biologics for ankylosing spondylitis: a network meta-analysis.
literature.abstract: Uveitis is a common extra-articular manifestation of ankylosing spondylitis (AS), and a systematic analysis of the effects of biologics on new-onset and recurrent uveitis is clinically important.

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: IL-17A 在脊椎關節炎（SpA）發病機制中扮演核心角色：Th17 細胞及 ILC3 於骶髂關節與附著點（enthesis）分泌 IL-17A，驅動 NF-κB 及 MAPK 路徑，造成關節炎症、軟骨損傷與病理性新骨形成（via BMP/Wnt）。Ixekizumab 以高親和力選擇性中和 IL-17A，已在 SPIRIT-P1（PsA）、SPIRIT-P2（PsA）、COAST-V/W（放射線影像學 axial SpA）等多項 Phase 3 RCT 中確立療效。此適應症在全球多國已獲核准，屬已知療效領域。⚠️ 注意：當地核准狀態需另行確認。
Kummell 病（創傷後椎體骨壞死/延遲性椎體塌陷）為缺血性機械性病因，涉及微血管損傷後的骨壞死，而非 IL-17A 驅動的免疫炎症過程。Ixekizumab 的 IL-17A 抑制機轉與此疾病病理生理學無合理關聯，TxGNN 預測屬脊椎部位節點鄰近效應。
多關節型幼年特發性關節炎（polyJIA）中 Th17/IL-17A 軸有一定炎症貢獻，機轉上具合理性（同類藥物 Secukinumab 已在附著點炎相關關節炎 ERA 型 JIA 取得 Phase 3 數據）。然而 Ixekizumab 目前無任何 polyJIA 的臨床試驗登錄或文獻，分數雖高（0.964）但缺乏臨床證據支持，需與有據可查的競品策略區分。

clinical_trials.title: A Multicenter, Randomized, Double-Blind and Placebo-Controlled 16-Week Study Followed by Long Term Evaluation of Efficacy and Safety of Ixekizumab (LY2439821) in Chinese Patients With Radiographic Axial Spondyloarthritis
clinical_trials.brief_summary: The main purpose of this study is to evaluate the efficacy and safety of ixekizumab in Chinese participants with radiographic axial spondyloarthritis (r-axSpA).

relevance.reasoning: Phase 3 多中心隨機雙盲安慰劑對照試驗，已完成，n=147。對應 COAST-X 延伸或非放射線影像學 axial SpA 族群，高度直接相關。

clinical_trials.title: A Multicenter, Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo- Controlled 16-Week Study Followed by Long-Term Evaluation of Efficacy and Safety of Ixekizumab (LY2439821) in TNFi-Experienced Patients With Radiographic Axial Spondyloarthritis

relevance.reasoning: Phase 3 隨機雙盲安慰劑對照研究，已完成，n=316。COAST-W 試驗（生物製劑治療失敗的放射線影像學 axial SpA），為核准依據核心試驗，直接評估椎體炎症治療。

clinical_trials.title: A Multicenter, Randomized, Double-Blind, Active and Placebo-Controlled 16-Week Study Followed by Long-Term Evaluation of Efficacy and Safety of Ixekizumab (LY2439821) in bDMARD-Naive Patients With Radiographic Axial Spondyloarthritis
clinical_trials.brief_summary: The main purpose of this study is to evaluate the safety and efficacy of the study drug known as ixekizumab in biological disease-modifying anti-rheumatic drugs (bDMARDs)-naive participants with radiographic axial spondyloarthritis (rad-axSpA).

relevance.reasoning: Phase 3 隨機雙盲含主動對照組研究，已完成，n=341。COAST-V 試驗（生物製劑初治放射線影像學 axial SpA），最重要的核准支持 pivotal 試驗之一，直接評估 Ixekizumab 對椎體炎症的療效。

clinical_trials.title: A Multicenter, Long-Term Extension Study of 104 Weeks, Including a Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled 40-Week Randomized Withdrawal-Retreatment Period, to Evaluate the Maintenance of Treatment Effect of Ixekizumab (LY2439821) in Patients With Axial Spondyloarthritis
clinical_trials.brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate, in participants having achieved a state of sustained remission, if the ixekizumab treatment groups are superior to the placebo group in maintaining response during the randomized withdrawal-retreatment period in participants with axial spondyloarthritis.

relevance.reasoning: Phase 3 長期延伸研究（104 週），已完成，n=773。整合 COAST-V/W 患者，提供 Ixekizumab 長達兩年的安全性與療效維持數據，為支持長期用藥策略的關鍵依據。

literature.abstract: Biologic disease-modifying anti-rheumatic drugs (bDMARDs), including certolizumab pegol (CZP), are effective treatment options for the management of non-radiographic spondyloarthritis (nr-axSpA). In the absence of head-to-head comparisons in nr-axSpA, we conducted a systematic literature review (SLR) and indirect treatment comparison (ITC) to better understand the comparative efficacy of CZP vs. other bDMARDs.

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: 軸性脊椎關節炎（axial SpA）為椎體炎症疾患的核心代表，IL-17A 由 Th17 細胞及 ILC3 在骶髂關節與脊椎附著點局部分泌，驅動椎間盤炎、骨炎及結構損傷（bamboo spine）。COAST 系列完整 Phase 3 RCT（COAST-V n=341 放射線影像學初治；COAST-W n=316 生物製劑治療失敗；COAST-X n=303 非放射線影像學 axial SpA）已建立完整療效與安全性數據。2025 年真實世界研究（n=709，PMID 40701624）進一步驗證臨床有效性。⚠️ 注意：當地核准狀態需另行確認；若已核准，此屬已知適應症而非再利用。
牙齦纖維瘤病為遺傳性纖維增生疾患（主要與 SOS1、HRas、REST 等基因突變相關），病理為非炎症性間葉組織過度增殖（膠原沉積）。IL-17A 炎症路徑與此疾病發病機制無已知關聯。TxGNN 預測分數（0.922）可能源於 KG 中結締組織疾病節點群集效應，屬圖譜拓撲噪訊，無生物學合理性支持。
